evidence: Average views per Reel (ours + HeyCatch): 125 on Oct 11-24, 79 on Oct 25-Nov 7, mostly because HeyCatch posted half as many Reels (28 to 14).
Our Reels: 71 views on average with a 21% 3-second hold; HeyCatch holds 32-40%. Average watch on ours is about 3 seconds of a 12-15 second Reel.
Our Reels averaged 45 views on Nov 1-3 and 93 on Nov 4-7.
One leftover item wins: micrometer-set-small-tools 159 views, drilling-rig-parked 134, stripped-well-pump 98, plumbing-part-label 97.
